name: physics-olympiad-multilingual-benchmark
description: A multilingual collection of physics olympiad problems intended to evaluate models' physics problem-solving and reasoning ability across languages. The benchmark contains physics questions (often requiring multi-step reasoning and quantitative answers) paired with reference solutions or labels in multiple languages. It is used to assess accuracy of models on challenging, domain-specific physics tasks.
evaluation_method: accuracy (exact_match or numeric/solution equivalence when applicable)
reputation: Niche dataset for evaluating multilingual physics reasoning; limited but growing awareness among researchers working on scientific reasoning benchmarks.
